title: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
abstract: arXiv:2609.33935v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

translated_title: 通过时空类比统一视频任务
translated_abstract: 将视频模型适配到新任务通常需要专门的数据整理和微调。虽然视觉类比通过在上下文中指定任务提供了一种无需训练的替代方案，但它仍局限于图像领域。为了探索基于类比的方法能否统一多样化的视频任务并泛化到分布外场景，我们提出了 ViGeo，这是一个通过时空画布补全将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频领域的框架。在具有严格训练-测试划分的多样化任务分类体系上进行评估，ViGeo 能够泛化到未见过的视频操作和零样本模态（例如事件相机）。最后，我们识别出任务内化现象，即与预训练任务关联的查询格式会覆盖演示内容，并证明这种捷径可以通过少量与任务无关的数据来消除，突出了将提示格式与任务身份去相关化的必要性。
tldr: 本文提出ViGeo框架，通过时空画布补全将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频领域，无需训练即可统一多种视频任务，并泛化到未见过的视频操作和零样本模态（如事件相机），同时发现并可通过少量无关数据消除“任务内化”这一提示捷径问题。
en_tdlr: ViGeo extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion, unifying diverse video tasks training-free while generalizing to unseen manipulations and zero-shot modalities, and identifies task internalization shortcuts that can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data.
